findings.title: The retracted k1 claim ('約0.15秒遅れ' / '7/30全周で…約0.15秒遅い') survives inside the 7 k1 top-view PNGs and in events.json notesJa
findings.problem: R1-01 removed the false k1 sentence from the HTML of B and C, but the comparison page's top-view schematics are PNGs generated at 19:55 (all 107, before round 1) by scripts/build_schematics.py, whose note for kerbContact/k1 is hard-coded as '注: k1は3DCGのブロック線の先端形状で乗った瞬間の距離が大きく出る（約0.15秒遅れの指摘・個別確認待ち）'. That line is printed on the 7 k1 contact cards directly under the card note that now says '0.09〜0.36秒遅く始まり（L6だけ0.12秒早い）…0.41秒早く'. scripts/build_events.py line 249 likewise writes '評価では7/30全周で3DCGの接触が約0.15秒遅いと指摘' into events.json notesJa for the same 7 events; the page hides it only because build_page.py's NOTE_MAP substitutes the text, so the data file and any future regeneration still carry the claim. Both text-based acceptance checks of R1-01 (grep on the HTML) could not see it.
findings.evidence: scripts/build_schematics.py:306; scripts/build_events.py:249; events.json notesJa of contact-0730-L1-k1 … L6-k1 (7 events); schematic/*.png all mtime 19:55 (107 files); viewed contact-0730-L1-k1, contact-0730-L5-k1-1 and contact-0730-L5-k1-2 top views in artifacts/event-comparison-2026-10-22/tmp/round3/*_r3.jpg — the stale note is legible on each; the page HTML has 0 occurrences of '約0.15秒' / '全周で3DCG' (NOTE_MAP override).
findings.fix: 1) In build_schematics.py replace the note with '注: k1は3DCGのブロック線の先端形状で乗った瞬間の距離が大きく出る（7/30は6周中5周で0.09〜0.36秒遅れ、L6は0.12秒早い。個別確認待ち）'. 2) In build_events.py replace the notesJa sentence with the same facts (keep the leading 'k1（コカ・コーラ）' so NOTE_MAP's key 'k1（コカ' still matches), and patch the 7 notesJa strings in events.json in place with a small python script (no other field changes); because frames/manifest.json records the old events.json sha256, record the new sha256 and the reason in verify.json (or in the frames manifest as a note) so the provenance chain stays explicit. 3) Regenerate only the 7 k1 schematics: pipeline/.venv-sr python -I scripts/build_schematics.py --only contact-0730-L1-k1 contact-0730-L2-k1 contact-0730-L3-k1 contact-0730-L4-k1 contact-0730-L5-k1-1 contact-0730-L5-k1-2 contact-0730-L6-k1 (numbers only, no video, no server; the builder re-asserts the recomputed CG gaps against events.json within 0.01 m). 4) Rebuild the page (build_page.py) and re-run qa_page.mjs.

findings.title: '縁石に乗る瞬間の時刻は、ロガーと数十ミリ秒で合っています' is true for the median only
findings.problem: In これで何が言えるか bullet 1 the kerb-contact time is listed with turn-in and minimum speed as agreeing with the logger 'within tens of milliseconds'. For the 20 7/30 contacts where the 3DCG reaches the block line, the median dt is +0.03 s but the per-event |dt| is typically 0.14 s and 0.36 s at the 90 % point, because the contact instant depends on the lateral position error at a shallow approach angle (the 3.3 m typical along-track error stated under the gap table). A reader will take the clause as a per-event timing accuracy, which it is not.
findings.evidence: summary.alongTrack.contactFirstBlock.fuji_aim_2020_07_30.dt: n 20, median 0.03, medianAbs 0.141, p90Abs 0.356 (reproduced from event_table block.dtFirst in this round).
findings.fix: Change the clause to '切り始め・最低速度の時刻はロガーと数十ミリ秒で合っています。縁石に乗る瞬間も中央値では+0.03秒ですが、1回ごとには典型0.14秒（90%値0.36秒）ずれます。これは時計のずれではなく、浅い角度で縁石に近づくため横の位置誤差が時刻の差になるものです。'
findings.acceptance: B contains the 0.14 s / 0.36 s per-event values next to the +0.03 s median; the values equal summary.alongTrack.contactFirstBlock 7/30 dt medianAbs / p90Abs (0.141 / 0.356).
